english:
A slab of raw meat packed with fat and cracked bone, thrown to buy you a way out.

The nearest predator breaks off whatever it is doing - including chasing you - and stops to eat. ONE animal per slab: a pack will not all stop for the same piece of meat, so bring enough.

Works on dire wolves and zombie bears too - they will eat and give you your opening, but dead things never follow you home.

Feed a LIVING wolf, coyote, mountain lion or bear five times and it stops being a predator and starts being yours.

Hold to aim, release to throw. It only works once it hits the ground.

Bait rendered down in a pot until the smell carries half again as far, laced with testosterone extract.\n\nPulls from further out, holds the animal longer, and counts as two feeds - which is the sane way to tame a grizzly, because standing next to one for five meals rarely ends well.
